meaning:
foundation, appointment
Also means: me.yus.sa.dah (מְיֻסָּדָה "foundation" H4328)

elsewhere.note: Every stroke of the rod of punishment, which Yahweh will lay on him, will be with the sound of tambourines and harps. He will fight with them in battles…
I saw also that the house had a raised base all around. The foundations of the side rooms were a full reed of six great cubits.
